2893-3875-5455-8345.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Bristly Bill trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Bristly Bill trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2558-4779-8347--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-4779-8347--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Sela triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a 2/2 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

1453-6495--5.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat
1453-6495--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

240-4785-5470-8095.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat from step 2.

1170-2099-3836-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2099-3836-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Urza.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

5153-7150-7715.easyPrerequisites: You haven't activated Kirol's ability this turn.
5153-7150-7715.description:
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Sunstrike Legionnaire. copying The Mighty Thor's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of The Mighty Thor's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping Sunstrike Legionnaire.
Repeat from step 2.

215-729-7404.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}
215-729-7404.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}{G}.
Activate Oviya by paying {G} and tapping it, putting Great Oak Guardian from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Great Oak Guardian enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Great Oak Guardian from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4478-6438.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4478-6438.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Elsha, triggering Breath of Fury and Elsha.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

101-372-7339.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Go Ninja Go exiled by Abdel Adrian.
101-372-7339.description:
Cast Go Ninja Go by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Vampire Charmseeker and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Vampire Charmseeker trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Go Ninja Go from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Go Ninja Go.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Vampire Charmseeker and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1171-1409-1849.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, casting a copy of Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate the Black Lotus token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Garth One-Eye by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Garth One-Eye enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.

215-729-2404-7014.notablePrerequisites:
North Pole Patrol does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least eight creatures.
215-729-2404-7014.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least eight {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Great Oak Guardian to your hand.
Cast Great Oak Guardian by paying {2}{G}.
When Great Oak Guardian enters, it triggers itself, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate North Pole Patrol any number of times.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-2044-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Peema Outrider.
When Peema Outrider dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Peema Outrider enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2034-5220-5477-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
1270-2034-5220-5477-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating three creature tokens and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

1309-3542-3647.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1309-3542-3647.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Salvager of Secrets and Palinchron
When Salvager of Secrets and Palinchron enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
1309-3542-3647.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Palinchron.

826-3767-3918-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
826-3767-3918-5527.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Five Hundred Year Diary's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-6095-6797.notablePrerequisites:
You have a Zombie creature card in your graveyard.
Creatures you control can tap to produce enough mana to cast the Zombie in your graveyard.
Zul Ashur does not have summoning sickness.
1636-6095-6797.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting a Zombie card in your graveyard.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding enough mana to cast the Zombie.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Zombie, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train.
Repeat.

372-624-4681.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Phantasmal Image.
372-624-4681.description:
Cast Phantasmal Image by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Put the original Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Phantasmal Image's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Phantasmal Image ability, choosing to exile Karmic Guide until Phantasmal Image leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Phantasmal Image into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Abdel Adrian's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian ability, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Phantasmal Image from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

771-1031-2276-5990-6229.notablePrerequisites:
Tetsuo has an Equipment attached to it with mana value 5 or greater.
Tetsuo does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Relearn or Said must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
771-1031-2276-5990-6229.description:
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Savage Beating without paying its mana cost, choosing its second mode.
Invocation of the Founders triggers, copying Savage Beating.
Resolve both Savage Beatings, causing you to get two additional combat phases after this one.
Move to your first combat phase.
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Relearn without paying its mana cost, targeting Said
Invocation of the Founders triggers, copying Relearn, targeting Savage Beating.
Resolve both Relearns, causing you to return Said and Savage Beating from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second combat phase.
Repeat steps 1 through 4 one additional time.
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Said without paying its mana cost, targeting Relearn.
Invocation of the Founders triggers, copying Said, targeting Savage Beating.
Resolve both Saids, causing you to return Relearn and Savage Beating from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second combat phase, and repeat from step 1.

413-1636-2857.notablePrerequisites:
Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
413-1636-2857.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1.
When the creature dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers, returning the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

4285-5959.manaNeeded: {R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional sorcery
4285-5959.notablePrerequisites:
You have not cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
You have a sorcery card in hand.
4285-5959.description:
Cast the additional sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Alania triggers; choose not to have an opponent draw a card.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance by paying {R}{R}, targeting the additional sorcery.
Alania triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card and you to copy Increasing Vengeance, with the copy targeting the original Increasing Vengeance.
Resolve the copy of Increasing Vengeance, copying the original Increasing Vengeance, with the copy targeting the original Increasing Vengeance.
Repeat step 5.

1354-4050-5851.manaNeeded: {9}{G}{G}{G}{G} at most, depending on how many Stormsplitters you control
1354-4050-5851.description:
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Resolve Wurmcalling, creating a 1/1 Wurm creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Wurm, adding {G}.
If you control at least 8 Stormsplitters, activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Stormsplitter tokens, adding {3}{G}.
Repeat.

1274-2060-2625-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Kibo does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Kibo.
1274-2060-2625-4222.description:
Activate Kibo by tapping it, causing each player to create a Banana artifact token.
Activate the Banana by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R/G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Kibo.
Repeat.

328-387-2034-2693-3263.notablePrerequisites: Gray Merchant in hand.You control less than two Thrulls.
328-387-2034-2693-3263.description:
Cast Gray Merchant by paying {5}.
Endrek Sahr triggers, creating five 1/1 Thrull creature tokens.
Gray Merchant enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose at least four life and you to gain life equal to the life you gained this way.
Activate Ashnod's Altar six times by sacrificing Gray Merchant and five Thrulls, adding twelve {C}.
Activate Phyrexian Reclamation by paying {2} and two life, returning Gray Merchant from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-1414-3028.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Nissa.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Nissa's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

224-433-5233.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Repeat.
